applicability: Equivalent Rectangular Bandwidth auditory-filter width and ERB-rate scale position for a claimed critical bandwidth at a given center frequency
assumptions: the auditory filter is well-approximated by the Glasberg & Moore (1990) roex-based ERB fit
the claimed bandwidth was derived under conditions comparable to the standard notched-noise paradigm
excluded: listener subjective preference, annoyance or discomfort judgments
individual listener variability in auditory filter width
uncertainty: Standard, widely-cited psychoacoustic model; hand-verified before use (ERB(1000 Hz)=132.639 Hz, matching the commonly cited ~132 Hz figure). Fitted range documented as roughly 100 Hz-10 kHz.
limits_policy: Model applicability flagged outside the documented 100 Hz-10 kHz fitted range rather than silently trusted.
